Container.Name: obsidian-tc
Container.Overview: MCP server for your Obsidian vault, for use on your local network. Clients connect with a bearer token minted from the container console. [br][br] [b]Before you start:[/b] create the config folder and copy deploy/config/obsidian-tc.config.json from the repository into it as obsidian-tc.config.json. Generate the JWT secret with openssl rand -hex 32 and paste it into the secret field. [br][br] [b]Address:[/b] set the allowed host and audience fields to the host name or IP and port you type in the browser, for example tower.local:8765. Never use a wildcard. [br][br] [b]Remote access:[/b] not configured by this template. See the home-server guide in the repository docs.

Config.Name: Vault folder
Config.Description: Your Obsidian vault folder on the host.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Holds obsidian-tc.config.json. Copy the config file here before the first start.

Config.Name: Cache folder
Config.Description: Search index and cache. Keep it on appdata.

Config.Name: Allowed hosts
Config.Description: Host and port you type in the browser, exact entries, comma separated. No wildcard.

Config.Name: Audience
Config.Description: The same address as an http:// URL.

Config.Name: Config file path
Config.Description: Path of the config file inside the container.

Config.Name: Vault path
Config.Description: Vault path inside the container. Keep the default.

Config.Name: Cache path
Config.Description: Cache path inside the container. Keep the default.

Config.Name: Container port
Config.Description: Port the server listens on inside the container. Keep the default.
